SabreOfSacrifice.description: When <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Dreir</style> or <style="Faction_AstraMilitarum">Death Riders</style> adjacent to Dreir are <style="Charging">charging</style>, their attacks <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppress</style> their targets for 1 round. After charging and until the start of their next turn, they additionally have <style="Stat_Armor">+{[extraArmor]} Armour</style> for each friendly unit that has been defeated this battle.
